summary: Iteration 2: tested new features - precise Swiss Ephemeris chart, daily/weekly/yearly horoscope with caching, family profiles CRUD (auth-gated), and frontend flows (Horoscope page, Calculator save-profile, precision badge, Dashboard Family & Friends use/delete, prefill). All 9 new backend tests pass; existing regression suite untouched. All frontend flows pass.
critical_code_review_comments: Horoscope cache key uses UTC date only; users near UTC boundary may see 'yesterday's' forecast briefly - low priority.
generate_horoscope/generate_ai_reading duplicate LLM boilerplate (~30 lines each). Could be extracted to a shared helper.
server.py is 427 lines; approaching the 700-line threshold - fine for now but consider modularising (routes/auth, routes/astrology, routes/profiles).
test_credentials: admin/Rashi@2026 works. New signup users created dynamically with unique email + User@2026.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test profiles + user accounts created during tests; profile deleted at end of frontend flow.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests split into test_rashisense.py (regression) and test_new_features.py (iteration 2 features). Frontend signup form uses 3 unnamed inputs (name, email-or-username, password) - use nth-index selection. Horoscope AI calls take ~15-20s first time then are cached. Swiss Ephemeris badge is text 'Swiss Ephemeris · Lahiri' on result card.
